title: Crimson Badlands

{{construction}} {{Location Infobox |image = Crimson Badlands |address = Outside Castle Village |occupants = }} '''{{PAGENAME}}''' is a new area added in Stardew Valley Expanded that contains new monsters, fish, foragables, and more. In order to unlock it, the player must have seen the event [[Quests/Nexus Warp/|Nexus Warp: Galdoran Continent]]. It is accesible by utilizing the minecart from [[Castle Village Outpost]] and later on, the warp in the [[Enchanted Grove]]. There are several locations within the Crimson Badlands, including the entrance to [[Castle Village]] to the north (not accessible as of 1.14.35), an oasis in the southeast, a skeleton graveyard in the south, and the entrance to Treasure Cave to the southwest. To the far west of the Badlands is the [[Iridium Quarry]], an off-shoot of the Badlands that is filled with Iridium Nodes, but is guarded by stronger monsters.
